cenas.ecra: Started near the back. Finished on the podium.
cenas.fala: Max Verstappen started twenty-first in Brazil. And he finished second. In the rain.

cenas.ecra: Qualified 16th, then started even further back
cenas.detalhe: Twenty cars ahead on a wet track.
cenas.fala: On Saturday he only qualified sixteenth. On Sunday he started even further back, with twenty cars ahead of him on a soaking wet track.

cenas.ecra: Norris won from pole and never looked back
cenas.fala: Up front, Lando Norris won from pole, fourteen and a half seconds clear.

cenas.detalhe: Hadjar 3rd: two Red Bulls on the podium. Mercedes win the constructors' title.
cenas.fala: But Max gained nineteen places in seventy-one laps. Hadjar took third, so two Red Bulls on the podium. And Mercedes? They sealed the constructors' title with fourth and fifth.

cenas.detalhe: Yes or no in the comments.
cenas.fala: Comeback of the year? Drop a yes or a no in the comments, and follow for tomorrow's story.

legenda_post: 21st to 2nd in the Interlagos rain 🌧️ Verstappen gained 19 places, Norris won from pole and Mercedes sealed the constructors' title. Comeback of the year? Yes or no 👇
